text: Land Encounters And Points Of Interest

Original mod description: \\n\\nDo you feel the Realm of Chaos map we ended up with is big but quite empty? Do you believe that a world as big and alive as the Warhammer world should offer more than travelling from city to city through vast nothingness to besiege another city, or chase a random fleeing army? Are you tired of never having more random enemies to fight, like your classic slavers or expeditionary forces?\\n\\nOriginally, a fellow modder called Anyndel imported the sea battles onto land for Warhammer 2 Mortal Empires. I loved his mod but always felt it was missing more. He abandoned it, but it was still visible in the Workshop. And so, with the coming of Warhammer 3, me wanting to mod the final game in the trilogy and Anyndel retiring, I ended up giving it a shot.
